And the men of Judah gathered, four hundred {OCR?} thousand fighting men.
And Jeroboam was defeated,
and fifty thousand {OCR?} from Israel fell.
Abijah took fourteen wives,
and he had twenty-four sons,
and sixteen daughters.
And Ahijah and also Shemaiah were prophesying.
After Abijah, Asa his son [reigned] forty-one years.
And in his tenth year,
Zerah the Ethiopian king,
having taken with him Ioebas Libuas {OCR?}
(Elibuas) {OCR?},
with a thousand thousand and six hundred thousand Ethiopians and Libyans, came to battle against Judah.
And Asa went out and struck them in Gerar,
and was victorious.
And in his fifteenth year he burned the idols.
And he also deposed (dismissed) his mother from the kingdom,
because she made a feast for Ashtoreth;
and he burned her carved image.
He also removed the fornicators {OCR?} from the land.
And in the twenty-ninth year of Asa, Elah reigned over Israel for two years.
And then Zimri, having killed Elah the son of Baasha his master,
reigned seven days.
Then Israel was divided:
part of them with Tibni,
and part of them with Omri.
And then (and when) Omri prevailed, Tibni died.
Now Zimri, when he saw that the people had submitted to Omri,
burned the palace and himself.
And Omri, having reigned in Tirzah six years, bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer its owner,
and built on it a city and called it Samaria,
the one which was afterwards called Sebastia,
and that is Nablus (Neapolis,
Nablus?).
Now Omri reigned twelve years.
After Asa, Jehoshaphat his son [reigned] twenty-five years.
And in his second year, Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel twenty-three years.
He took as his wife Jezebel, daughter of Ethbaal king of Tyre and Sidon.
And he rebuilt Jericho, which Joshua the son of Nun had cursed:
at the cost of Abiram his firstborn he laid its foundation,
and at the cost of Segub his youngest he set up its gates.
At this time Elijah, and Obadiah, and Abihud, and Uzziel, and Micaiah son of Imlah {OCR?} were prophesying;
and the false prophets Zedekiah, and Eleazar, and four hundred others.
Zedekiah the false prophet made horns of iron, and placed them on his head, and said to Ahab:
"With these you shall gore the Edomites (Arameans) {OCR?} and finish them off."
